verdict.rationale: Muse explicitly has its own VM with a file system and terminal, writes its own code and builds tools/dashboards (e.g., spending trackers, sleep pattern dashboards), and all generated files are stored in the VM where users can inspect, edit, and download them freely. This directly supports code-driven analysis, computed outputs, and downloadable file deliverables. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'charts' as a rendered output type, independent hands-on verification of code-execution accuracy/quality, and confirmation of chart-specific export formats.
